item.title: When precise inference is wrong: Diagnosing model misspecification with applications to cosmic dawn and reionisation
item.description: arXiv:2610.40770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As observations of the cosmic dawn (CD) and epoch of reionisation (EoR) rapidly improve in precision, the approximate forward models used to interpret them might struggle to keep pace. Bayesian inference with a misspecified model, one that cannot represent the processes generating the observations, can yield tightly constrained, yet misleading and biased astrophysics, with different parts of the observations favouring incompatible parameter values.
